entities.name: CATL
entities.summary: 宁德时代 (SZSE:300750 / HKEX:03750). World's largest EV + grid-scale lithium-ion battery maker. FY2025: 661 GWh shipped (+39%), revenue ¥423.7 bn (+17%), net profit ¥72.2 bn (+42%, record). 37-38% global EV-battery share, 38-43% global ESS share (SNE Research). Plants in Germany, Hungary, Spain (50:50 JV with Stellantis), US (licensing with Ford / Tesla due to IRA), Indonesia (PT Antam JV). TTM P/E 24.2× — discount to peer median ~35× despite highest margins and share. 1 trillion HK + RMB float; dual-listed Shenzhen ChiNext (2018) and HKEX (May-2025).
